additional_info.body:
Hello Nenad, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
Regarding your questions about the ELMS.
Heartbeat and Fallback
Although the Heartbeat is only optional, it's highly recommended to be used since the communication interface relies on TCP protocol which attempts automatic re-connection and is slow to report communication loss. With the heartbeat you have fast and reliable communication loss monitoring. So the final answer is, no you do not need the heartbeat to have the fallback to work, even though it's recommended.
DC3 and DC4 error
Is it possible that the ELMS is monitoring one of the following registers?
Please let me know your feedback.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
